label: lehome-rollout-builder
on-start:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euxo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git docker.io pigz python3-pip python3-venv
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
mkdir -p /etc/docker /workspace /var/log
cat >/etc/docker/daemon.json <<'JSON'
{"storage-driver":"overlay2","iptables":false,"ip6tables":false,"bridge":"none"}
JSON
(dockerd --iptables=false --ip6tables=false --bridge=none >>/var/log/dockerd.log 2>&1 &)
for i in $(seq 1 90); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'dockerd failed' >&2; tail -n 200 /var/log/dockerd.log >&2; exit 1; }
# Prefer env, fall back to process environment injection from Vast
: "${HF_TOKEN:?HF_TOKEN required}"
BUILD_BRANCH="${BUILD_BRANCH:-ryanjin333/vast-template-sync}"
IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG:-ghcr.io/ryanjin333/lehome-rollout:latest}"
rm -rf /tmp/src
git clone --depth 1 --branch "$BUILD_BRANCH" https://github.com/ryanjin333/lehome-challenge.git /tmp/src
cd /tmp/src/docker/rollout
# DinD: host network is more reliable for HF downloads during build
sed -i 's|--platform "${PLATFORM}" \\|--platform "${PLATFORM}" --network host \\|' build.sh || true
IMAGE_TAG="$IMAGE_TAG" PUSH=0 ./build.sh 2>&1 | tee /var/log/image-build.log
docker image inspect "$IMAGE_TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo BUILD_FAILED; exit 1; }
echo BUILD_DONE
docker save "$IMAGE_TAG" | pigz -p "$(nproc)" > /workspace/lehome-rollout.tar.gz
echo "SAVE_DONE $(du -h /workspace/lehome-rollout.tar.gz | cut -f1)"
pip3 install -q 'huggingface_hub[cli,hf_transfer]'
HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1 HF_TOKEN="$HF_TOKEN" hf upload --repo-type dataset ryanjin333/lehome-rollout-image /workspace/lehome-rollout.tar.gz lehome-rollout.tar.gz
echo HF_UPLOAD_DONE
echo "ALL_DONE $(date -u)"
